subject: Nimbusly launch — PR assets, quote signoff & embargo timing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbusly.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbusly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbusly launch — PR assets, quote signoff & embargo timing

Hi Priya / Tom —

Congrats again on the product milestone — excited to get this over the line with you. We want to make the press announcement clean and make sure the quote from Nimbusly + the short customer blurb are locked before we go live. A few asks from our side: 

1) Confirm the final quote you want attributed to Nimbusly (name + title).
2) Confirm embargo window — we propose Sept 22, 2027 at 09:00 PDT (12:00 EDT) for wide distribution. If you need a different time-zone sync, say so.
3) Please send final logo (PNG and SVG) and the 2–3 line customer blurb we can use in the press release and case brief.

I’ve attached a working draft of the release for your review (Draft_Press_Release_v1.docx) and included an assets folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NimbuslyPRAssets.

Marissa — can your team take the lead on the quote wording / one-liner for the case study? Laura — heads up that we may ask for the Redwood corporate quote to be signed off by legal.

Priya — would EchoPoint (cc Kate) be handling distribution? If yes, Kate, can you confirm distribution lists (trade, tier-1 business press, and selected regional outlets)?

Thanks — short timeline but should be do-able.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: Draft_Press_Release_v1.docx, Nimbusly_Logo_RGB.png
From: Priya Shah <priya@nimbusly.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbusly.com>, Kate Reynolds <kate@echopointpr.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbusly launch — PR assets, quote signoff & embargo timing

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers: 

1) Quote — please use the following, attributed to me: 
"Redwood Inference has been instrumental in letting us scale conversational features without blowing up costs. Their routing and caching make real-time user experiences practical at scale." — Priya Shah, Head of Product, Nimbusly

2) Embargo — Sept 22 at 09:00 PDT works for us. We’ll aim to have legal approve by Sept 20 EOD.

3) Assets — attaching Nimbusly_Logo_RGB.png here and I’ll upload SVGs to the drive by end of day. Also attaching Nimbusly_Redwood_CaseStudy_brief.pdf — it’s a short factual blurb we’re happy to use.

Kate — EchoPoint will run distribution. Please confirm the final list and confirm if you need any more exclusive windows.

Tom — looping you for any last technical details or metrics you want quoted.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Product
Nimbusly
priya@nimbusly.com

Attachments: Nimbusly_Logo_RGB.png, Nimbusly_Redwood_CaseStudy_brief.pdf
From: Kate Reynolds <kate@echopointpr.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbusly.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbusly.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbusly launch — PR assets, quote signoff & embargo timing

Thanks Priya, Ben — noted. Plan from EchoPoint: 

- Draft embargoed release distribution to trade + business press on Sept 22, 09:00 PDT. 
- One-tier exclusive option: we can offer TechWire a 24-hour exclusive if Nimbusly wants. Recommend not doing multiple exclusives unless strategic.
- Need final executive quote for Redwood (short) and Nimbusly by Sept 20, noon PDT to hit the distribution timeline.

I’ll circulate the proposed distribution list by EOD tomorrow and will include the embargo language we’ll require in the email to outlets.

Ben / Marissa — any restrictions on technical metrics (percent improvements / numbers) you want us to avoid publishing without signoff?

Kate Reynolds
Principal, Media Strategy
EchoPoint PR
kate@echopointpr.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbusly.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kate Reynolds <kate@echopointpr.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbusly launch — PR assets, quote signoff & embargo timing

Awesome — thank you Priya and Kate. A few internal notes and requests: 

- I’ll take the Nimbusly quote verbatim as provided. Can we get the preferred attribution line? (Priya included title but want the exact capitalization for the release.)
- Redwood corporate quote (short, 20–25 words) — suggested draft below for your edit: 
"We partnered with Nimbusly to deliver responsive, cost-efficient conversational features that keep users engaged at scale." — Laura Bennett, VP Communications, Redwood Inference

Laura — please confirm wording or edit. Sarah in legal flagged a small IP line — we should include a sentence that the release is factual and that no private customer data is being disclosed.

Evelyn — can marketing ops provide final logo lock and ensure the case brief PDF uses the Nimbusly-approved wording? I attached the working case brief to this thread for context.

If everyone signs off, I’ll upload the finalized release to the Drive folder and send the DocuSign for Nimbusly’s final approval (link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/NIM-PR-2027).

Thanks — aiming to be ready for distribution on the 22nd.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbusly.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@nimbusly.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Reynolds <kate@echopointpr.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbusly launch — PR assets, quote signoff & embargo timing

Quick technical clarification: please don’t include raw user counts in the release. We’re comfortable with percent improvements and latency stats that are aggregated. Suggested line: 
"Nimbusly reduced average inference latency by 42% and lowered per-token serving cost by over 30% after migrating to Redwood’s routing and caching configuration."

Priya — legal approved the quote and assets on our side; I’ve signed and uploaded the SVGs to the drive. 

Ben / Marissa — if you can push the updated release with the final Redwood quote and the IP/data sentence, we’ll sign the DocuSign by tomorrow morning and we’re good to go.

Thanks — Tom
VP Engineering
Nimbusly
tom.alvarez@nimbusly.com
